edges.effect_quant: A small and mixed literature suggest the direction is more reliable than any single pooled magnitude.
edges.mechanism: This factor likely influences Frailty progression through a mix of reserve, disability, social engagement, inflammation, and shared chronic-disease burden rather than one single biochemical pathway. That matters because some of these variables behave partly as markers of physiologic aging and partly as modifiable contributors.
edges.summary: A small and mixed literature link social participation to lower frailty progression in older adults. The average effect is usually unknown rather than dramatic, so this edge is better read as a risk modifier than a stand-alone cause or cure.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
